_readme: AGENT-ADDABLE enemy. Drop a new .json in data/enemies/. weight = relative spawn odds among eligible enemies; min_level gates when it appears; size_m = world height in meters. behavior.type: 'chase' (default) or 'charge' (params: interval, windup_sec, dash_speed_mult, dash_sec, trigger_range). phases=true walks through props (ghost). New behavior types require code (flagged exception).
